description: Review what an update from the original build would change — the same review the builder shows its maker, shaped for an agent. Returns the releases since the clone, the clean changes (added/changed/removed paths, with full incoming contents for added+changed), and CONFLICTS: files where this flow's own edits and the update collide, each with complete base/ours/theirs contents. RESOLUTION CONTRACT (match the builder's behavior): when both sides' changes serve different purposes, merge them yourself — one file keeping BOTH sides' improvements; never wholesale-pick a side out of convenience. ONLY when the two sides genuinely contradict on the same visible thing (a color, a layout, a label, a behavior) ask YOUR user which they want, in plain product language — describe the visible difference, never file names or code. Then call apply_upstream_update with exactly one resolution per conflict. The trees you see are already in THIS organization's table namespace — never rename tableName literals yourself. adoptMode: true means the merge base is unrecoverable, so no merge is possible: offer the user adopting the latest release wholesale (apply_upstream_update with adopt: true) or staying put. upToDate: true means there is nothing to do.
name: flow_get_upstream_update
title: Review a pending upstream update
